q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
Let me analyze this carefully step by step.

**(a) Time left until resolution:**
Today is 2026-08-13. Q2 FY2027 for NVIDIA would end around July 2026 (standard fiscal year). The earnings release and forward guidance would be provided in August 2026. This is essentially happening **now or imminently** — resolution is within days/weeks.

**(b) Most likely outcome and why:**

The CURRENT RESEARCH provides extremely specific and recent data:
- NVIDIA provided Q2 FY2027 forward guidance of approximately **$91.0 billion (±2%)** on May 20, 2026
- This is the actual guidance NVIDIA has already issued for this quarter
- Wall Street consensus is $91.8 billion, with a range of $90.3-$96.7 billion
- Q1 FY2027 actual revenue was $81.6 billion

Since the question asks "What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release?" and we have documentation that NVIDIA already provided this guidance on May 20, 2026, the answer is already known: approximately $91.0 billion.

The $91.0 billion ± 2% guidance translates to a range of roughly $89.2 billion to $92.8 billion, with the midpoint at $91.0 billion.

**(c) What would push the value lower?**
- If actual Q1 results disappointed or macro conditions deteriorated significantly between May and the Q2 earnings release
- Unexpected geopolitical issues affecting AI chip demand or exports
- However, guidance has already been issued, so revision downward becomes less likely unless circumstances changed dramatically

**(d) What would push the value higher?**
- Stronger than expected actual Q1 results (though these were already reported as $81.6B, beating estimates)
- Sustained AI demand stronger than anticipated
- NVIDIA could raise guidance at Q2 earnings, but this would be unusual mid-quarter
- However, guidance appears already locked in

**(e) Base rate or historical reference values:**

From the CURRENT RESEARCH:
- Q1 FY2027 actual: $81.6 billion (85% YoY growth)
- Q2 FY2027 forward guidance already provided: $91.0 billion ± 2%
- Wall Street analyst consensus: $91.8 billion (range $90.3-$96.7B)

The guidance appears already issued. The question asks what "will be" in the earnings release, which is about to happen or may have already happened. The most reliable data point is NVIDIA's own guidance of $91.0 billion.

**Analysis:**

The forward guidance has already been announced at $91.0 billion ± 2%. This is factual information from May 20, 2026. The earnings release for Q2 FY2027 would repeat or potentially revise this guidance, but revisions from guidance issued less than 3 months prior would be unusual unless conditions changed dramatically.

The median should center on $91.0 billion. The ±2% range suggests uncertainty or official range of $89.2-$92.8B, but the guidance itself is approximately $91.0B.

Given:
- Official guidance: ~$91.0B
- Analyst consensus: $91.8B
- Range provided: $89.3-$96.7B (analyst estimates)
- The fact that guidance was recently issued and is unlikely to be materially revised

My distribution should center tightly around $91.0B with modest spread reflecting the possibility of minor upward revision toward analyst consensus ($91.8B) or the possibility they hold the line at $91.0B.

q_45367.research_text: NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue is expected to be approximately $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%. This outlook, provided on May 20, 2026, by NVIDIA, does not include any Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027/). This guidance is above the average quarterly revenue estimate of $86.84 billion from LSEG analysts [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027/). Wall Street analysts' consensus for Q2 FY2027 revenue is $91.8 billion, with a range of $90.3 billion to $96.7 billion [tickerleague.com](https://tickerleague.com/companies/NVDA/estimates). NVIDIA reported record revenue of $81.6 billion for Q1 FY2027, an 85% increase year-over-year [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [barchart.com](https://www.barchart.com/story/news/3449043/what-to-expect-from-nvidia-s-q2-2027-earnings-report).
